import hashlib, json, re, stat
from pathlib import Path
qpath = Path('queries.json')
qbytes = qpath.read_bytes()
qmode = stat.S_IMODE(qpath.stat().st_mode)
queries = json.loads(qbytes)
plans = []
seen = set()
for item in queries['files']:
    name = item['path']
    assert name not in seen, f'duplicate path: {name}'
    seen.add(name)
    path = Path(name)
    original = path.read_bytes()
    mode = stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode)
    lines = re.findall(rb'["'^'"\\r\\n]*(?:\\r\\n|\\r|\\n)|["'^'"\\r\\n]+\\Z', original)
    assert b''.join(lines) == original
    offsets = [0]
    for line in lines:
        offsets.append(offsets[-1] + len(line))
    ranges = sorted((r['start'], r['end']) for r in item['ranges'])
    previous = 0
    edits = []
    for start, end in ranges:
        assert 1 <= start <= end <= len(lines), (name, start, end)
        assert start > previous, f'overlap: {name}'
        previous = end
        lo, hi = offsets[start-1], offsets[end]
        fragment = b''.join(lines[start-1:end])
        assert original[lo:hi] == fragment
        assert original.find(fragment) == lo and original.find(fragment, lo+1) == -1, f'nonunique fragment: {name}:{start}-{end}'
        replacement = b''.join(reversed(lines[start-1:end]))
        edits.append((lo, hi, fragment, replacement))
    expected = original
    for lo, hi, fragment, replacement in reversed(edits):
        expected = expected[:lo] + replacement + expected[hi:]
    final_terminator = lambda data: re.search(rb'(\\r\\n|\\r|\\n)\\Z', data).group(0) if re.search(rb'(\\r\\n|\\r|\\n)\\Z', data) else b''
    assert final_terminator(expected) == final_terminator(original), f'final newline change: {name}'
    plans.append((name, path, original, expected, mode, edits))
# All original fragments have been validated before any mutation.
for name, path, original, expected, mode, edits in plans:
    assert path.read_bytes() == original
    assert stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode) == mode
    with path.open('r+b') as stream:
        stream.write(expected)
        stream.truncate()
for name, path, original, expected, mode, edits in plans:
    actual = path.read_bytes()
    assert actual == expected, f'byte verification failed: {name}'
    assert stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode) == mode, f'permission change: {name}'
    cursor = 0
    for lo, hi, fragment, replacement in edits:
        assert actual[cursor:lo] == original[cursor:lo]
        assert actual[lo:hi] == replacement
        cursor = hi
    assert actual[cursor:] == original[cursor:]
    print(json.dumps({'path': name, 'original_sha256': hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(), 'final_sha256': hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest(), 'mode': oct(mode), 'blocks_verified': len(edits)}))
assert qpath.read_bytes() == qbytes
assert stat.S_IMODE(qpath.stat().st_mode) == qmode
print(json.dumps({'modified': sorted(name for name, _, original, expected, _, _ in plans if original "'!= expected), '"'verified': sorted(name for name, *_ in plans), 'blocks_reversed': True, 'unrelated_preserved': True}))
